messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites MS C++ code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
<perturbed_code_1>
#include <cstdio>
#include <iostream>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

int i, l;
string s;

bool dot() {
    return (i+2) < (l-1) && s[i+1] == 'o' && s[i+2] == 't';
}

bool at() {
    return (i+1) < l && s[i+1] == 't';
}

int main() {
    //freopen("input.txt", "r", stdin);

    cin >> s;

    l = s.length();

    cout << s[0];

    bool f = false;

    for (i = 1; i < l; i++) {
        if (s[i] == 'a' && !f && at()) {
            cout << '@';
            f = true;
            i += 2;
            continue;
        }

        if (s[i] == 'd' && dot()) {
            cout << '.';
            i += 3;
            continue;
        }

        cout << s[i];
    }

    return 0;
}
